items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Mel's father gave Zutty a watch and they had us at their home for dinner.

ctx.x: And that's why I say, Mel's father gave Zutty a watch and they had us at their home for dinner.
Yes, Mel Epstien. And they were so crazy about Zutty because they told Zutty you know, how kind he had been and all. And nobody else would listen to Mel, to Mel as a jazz piano player.
